name: waypoint
description: Waypoint agent plugin. Add this repository as a marketplace (local path, private or public GitHub) and install "waypoint" from the Discover tab.

plugins.name: waypoint
plugins.description: Attaches harness telemetry (agent, model, host, branch, changed files) to Waypoint run claims, checkpoints and completions, and suspends the agent while a blocking decision waits for the operator. Pair with the Waypoint MCP server from claude mcp add.
